- Total revenue reached £58,838.41 TW, representing a +48.9% WoW increase from £39,528.47 LW.
- Total revenue grew +350.9% YoY, demonstrating significant year-over-year expansion in week 2011-W06.
- VINTAGE UNION JACK MEMOBOARD dominated TW with £6,500.69 revenue and 11.0% share, driven by a +65233.6% WoW surge from £9.95 LW.
- CREAM HEART CARD HOLDER ranked second TW with £2,403.53 revenue and 4.1% share, posting a +910.8% WoW increase.
- GROW A FLYTRAP OR SUNFLOWER IN TIN achieved third place TW with £2,319.75 revenue and 3.9% share, up +3766.2% WoW.
- ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT experienced the largest WoW decline, falling -80.3% to £281.84 TW from £1,429.93 LW.
- BASKET OF FLOWERS SEWING KIT recorded the largest YoY increase at +1707.1%, reaching £10.20 LY.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated the most orders at 31 TW, down from 48 LW.
